pages.text: CyberFarm grows in $(l)three tiers$(). Each one is built out of what the tier before it makes, so you always know what to build next:

$(li)$(l)**1$()**: $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l), $(l:materials/circuits)Basic Circuits$(/l), Electrolyzer, a crafting table or the Fabricator, Basic and Mini Drone Frames, modules, addons, docks, the Assembler, Bio-Digester, Gas Turbine, Methane Extractor, Acid Synthesizer, Pyrolysis Oven, Water Pump

$(li)$(l)**2$()**: $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)Carbon Fiber$(/l), Advanced Circuits, Pyrolysis Oven (methane), Fabricator (acid), Advanced Frames, Steam Engine, Coolant Mixer, Waste Reprocessor, Advanced cables, Resonance Core, Mech Hangar, Laser Turret, the dishes
$(li)$(l)**3$()**: Elite Circuits, Fabricator (acid, uranium), Elite Frames, the Fission Reactor, the Steam Turbine, Elite cables, the Crystallizer, Range Module III and the mech
$(li)$(l)By hand$(): mine $(l)bauxite$(), smelt it into alumina, and run a Combustion Generator and an Electrolyzer for your first aluminum. Craft your first Basic Circuits at a crafting table.

$(li)$(l)Gas$(): the Advanced Circuits are etched with $(l)Acid$(), made from Nether $(l)sulfur$(); the Carbon Fiber is drawn out of $(l)Methane$() from a Methane Extractor. Both need the gas tier.$(br)$(li)$(l)Nuclear$(): the Elite Circuits need $(l)uranium$(), the reactor needs Elite Circuits.
Like real drones, the frames start in light $(l)aluminum$() and move on to $(l)carbon fiber$().
